standard_prerequisites.name: Extension along flat maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends gamma from A_even,+ to A_even (x)_R P along the flat map A_even -> A_even (x)_R P.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Certifies descent from A_even (x)_R P to A_even (x)_R R' via generators of the kernel.

core_obligations: Observe A'_even = A_even (x)_R R', reducing to extension of gamma.
Factor R -> R' through a polynomial algebra P; extend along the flat map A_even -> A_even (x)_R P by gamma-extends.
Show I' = ker(A_even,+ (x) P -> A_even,+ (x) R') is generated by x (x) f, whose gamma_n images f^n gamma_n(x) stay in I'; conclude by the kernel criterion.
Note the induced d and gamma then satisfy the dpdga axioms by base change of identities.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to extension of gamma, run the polynomial factorization, and close with the generator computation.
difficulty_reason: A two-lemma assembly with one explicit generator computation; the closing 'follows easily' covers only base-changed identities.
